sourceBrief: Create a memorable AutoPromote welcome film and social campaign from an idea alone, with no recorded footage. Show imagination becoming finished work, rather than a feature list.
prompt: Photoreal cinematic miniature world, tactile ivory origami paper boat with one crisp triangular sail and sharply folded hull, no writing on the paper. Warm amber practical light against deep petrol-blue shadows, natural film contrast, 35mm commercial cinematography. The same single small ivory paper boat is the only hero object. Extreme close-up at table level. A small ivory origami sailboat rests on a dark wooden desk beside one blank sheet of paper. A thin shimmering pool of water slowly spreads underneath the boat; the boat lifts gently and floats as the desk surface becomes a deep blue ocean. An impossible transformation shown with physically convincing water and crisp stable folds. Slow controlled camera push. Quiet amber light from the left. One uninterrupted five-second shot.
